line: February 1966: the first close-up of the Moon arrives at an English radio telescope as a newspaper fax, printed one line at a time in two inks, a day early and stretched too tall.
line_cn: 1966 年 2 月，月面的第一张近照被英国一座射电望远镜当成报社传真收下，一行一行印出来：早了一天，比例却拉高了。
uses: History told through a chain of media

motion.cuts: one-take UI flythrough or snap zoom

camera.expresses: the object is the world; texture becomes landscape
camera.serves: a print forming; a dial; frost; a fingerprint
entering a photograph; leaving a screen; zooming into a map

camera.expresses: presence, scale, long shadows crossing the lens
camera.serves: a landscape; a crime scene; a battlefield after
an object, a monument, a figure
a document to a building to a city
arrivals, a montage of hands-on steps

transitions: Allowed transitions: hard cut, shape match, block dissolve, fax-scan wipe, inversion flash, coarse-cell resolve, fall through the dots.
Across a dissolve or wipe both pictures hold still and share the composition.
Forbidden: cross-fades through grey, per-pixel dissolves over fine dots (they read as a grey double exposure), blurs as transitions, page turns.
labels: All text lives in the world: written, typed, stencilled, printed or stamped on an object, then dithered like everything else. No overlay captions.

Text is drawn high-resolution on the object's own canvas, bold enough to survive the 960×540 grid: CJK glyphs at least 11 internal px tall where they must be read (22 px at 1080p), Latin cap height at least 9 internal px. Thin handwriting gets a stroke; typewriter faces get a stroke; condensed display faces close up below ~20 px, so stamps use a heavy sans.

Roles: handwriting for logs and notes (a kai-style CJK hand, a casual Latin hand), typewriter for labels, a newspaper serif or condensed grotesk for print, a heavy sans for stamps and stencils. Fonts are OFL or Apache, subset to the characters used.
Bilingual lines: one line per language, native line first and larger.
motion: 30 fps, on ones. Because every pixel flips between two states, motion is visible as pattern change: keep camera moves smooth (spline keys, ease in and out) and avoid fast lateral pans across fine repeating structure.

No velocity cliffs. A sudden stop, a start at full speed or a 0.1 s hold mid-move reads as a stutter, because the whole pattern freezes or jumps at once. Join camera segments with continuous velocity (Hermite or Bézier, overlap and blend two segments), start a shot after a cut from rest or at the speed the cut implies, slow an orbit down rather than stopping it. As a reference, keep turns under about 3° per frame.

Big scale changes in log distance. A pull-back from one dot to a town is keyed on log(distance), starts from rest and peaks around 15 % per frame; a linear pull that is fastest on its first frame smears the whole picture.
Fine regular structure (lattice, mesh, grilles, rigging) must be built as few thick members or kept in silhouette; one-pixel lines that move produce crawling stairs.

native_moves.name: Print it line by line
native_moves.does: A picture appears one scan line at a time on paper (fax drum, plotter, receipt).
native_moves.fits: a weather chart arriving at a ship; a wanted poster on a police printer; a newborn's first scan.

native_moves.name: Change of dot
native_moves.does: Pass the camera from world to print to page: ordered dither becomes error diffusion becomes halftone.
native_moves.fits: a photograph's journey to a newspaper; a satellite image to an atlas; a painting to a postcard.

native_moves.name: Fall through the dots
native_moves.does: Push into a printed dot until it fills the frame, resolve the next world from coarse blocks.
native_moves.fits: entering a memory; going inside a map; a scan becoming the room it shows.

native_moves.name: Inversion strike
native_moves.does: Swap ink and paper for one frame at an impact.
native_moves.fits: a stamp or verdict; a camera flash; a lightning strike; a gunshot.

native_moves.name: Rim in the dark
native_moves.does: A dark object against a dark ground gets a paper outline from the edge rule; a backlit object becomes a drawn contour.
native_moves.fits: a spacecraft; a statue at night; a lighthouse.

native_moves.name: Density time-lapse
native_moves.does: A window, sky or wall goes from dense to sparse dots over a held move.
native_moves.fits: a night passing; a season; a fire dying.

score.note: small, slightly cold ensemble: clarinet, glockenspiel, pizzicato, detuned upright piano
